commit_message: feat(firewall): migrate native UFW console to shared terminal API

replacements.old: from libs.JBLibs.input import anyKey, confirm, get_input, select, select_item, selectFile

replacements.new:
def test_native_console_uses_shared_terminal_dispatcher(self):
        screen = firewall_menu.menu()
        rules = (
            SimpleNamespace(number=1, text="22/tcp ALLOW IN Anywhere"),
            SimpleNamespace(number=2, text="Apache ALLOW IN Anywhere"),
        )
        captured = {}

        def fake_terminal(**kwargs):
            captured.update(kwargs)
            ctx = firewall_menu.terminal_context(kwargs["context"])
            ctx.commands = kwargs["commands"]
            ctx.fnPrefix = kwargs["fnPrefix"]
            self.assertIn("[ 1] 22/tcp ALLOW IN Anywhere", kwargs["header"](ctx))
            self.assertIn(":list", str(list(ctx.help())))
            self.assertIn("Apache ALLOW IN Anywhere", kwargs["commands"]["list"].fn(ctx, ""))
            return None

        with patch.object(
            firewall_menu, "list_numbered_ufw_rules", return_value=rules
        ), patch.object(
            firewall_menu, "terminal", side_effect=fake_terminal
        ):
            result = screen.manage_native_ufw_rules(None)

        self.assertIsInstance(result, firewall_menu.onSelReturn)
        self.assertEqual(captured["historyKey"], "firewall-native-ufw")
        self.assertEqual(
            set(captured["commands"]),
            {"help", "srv", "info", "ver", "list", "list p"},
        )

# Changelog

## v2.14.0

- ADD JBLibs 1.2.34 zavádí sdílené veřejné `terminal()` API pro plnohodnotné příkazové konzole: readline editace a historie, dynamický `header/footer`, statický `title`, aplikační context, deklarativní prefix dispatcher a automaticky generovaný help z `terminal_command` metadata.
- UX Firewall Manager 0.9.0 převádí nativní UFW konzoli na sdílené `terminal()` API. `:help`, `:srv`, `:info`, `:ver`, `:list` a `:list p` jsou deklarativní read-only příkazy; šipky nahoru/dolů procházejí vlastní historii konzole a Backspace/kurzorové klávesy používají readline.
- SAFETY `add ...` a číslované Delete zůstávají mimo read-only dispatcher a zachovávají existující confirm, stable-snapshot, rollback a fresh-SSH ACK ochrany.

replacements.old: Status: **guarded manual UFW Apply implemented and cross-session ACK physically verified on dev-vm** as SysApps 2.13.1 / Firewall Manager 0.8.1 (2026-11-15). Hub/hourly auto-apply and production/new21 takeover remain disabled. Activation of an inactive UFW always requires one-time `sys_apps ufw <token>` acknowledgement from a different SSH transport; active Apply requires it only when changed managed rules can affect the current SSH management tuple. The native UFW console lists/deletes numbered rules, supports explicit confirmed ALLOW additions by port or existing `ufw app` profile, and exposes read-only `:srv`, `:info`, `:ver` and port/profile diagnostics. `:list` renders a persistent read-only numbered view and waits for acknowledgement before returning. Native Edit is intentionally absent; durable managed policy remains owned by local `firewall.json`. Shared JBLibs 1.2.33 provides immediate accepted-choice processing feedback before slower menu/input actions.

Hub/hourly auto-apply and production/new21 takeover remain disabled. Activation of an inactive UFW always requires one-time `sys_apps ufw <token>` acknowledgement from a different SSH transport; active Apply requires it only when changed managed rules can affect the current SSH management tuple. The native UFW console lists/deletes numbered rules, supports explicit confirmed ALLOW additions by port or existing `ufw app` profile, and exposes declarative read-only `:help`, `:srv`, `:info`, `:ver`, `:list` and `:list p` commands with readline editing/history. replacements.old: - Native console commands prefixed with `:` are read-only. `:srv` maps to `ufw app list`, `:info <profile>` to `ufw app info <profile>`, and `:list p <port|profile>` may inspect `ss`, numbered UFW rules and live iptables/ip6tables filter rules. `:list` must render its own numbered read-only view and wait for `anyKey` so the result cannot be immediately hidden by the console redraw. Never shell-evaluate console input; parse to validated argument arrays.
replacements.new: - Native console commands prefixed with `:` are read-only and must use shared JBLibs `terminal()` + `terminal_command` dispatcher/help metadata. `:srv` maps to `ufw app list`, `:info <profile>` to `ufw app info <profile>`, and `:list p <port|profile>` may inspect `ss`, numbered UFW rules and live iptables/ip6tables filter rules. Command results stay visible inside the terminal loop until the next input; do not reintroduce `anyKey` or a private input loop. Never shell-evaluate console input; parse mutating input to validated argument arrays.
